title: Change the light
description: A turning sun, a crossfade and a passing highlight make a theme change feel considered.
useCase: Connect the light and dark states of an appearance control.
reducedMotion: The labels and colors still change; icon rotation and the moving highlight are removed.
limitations: The theme change is scoped to this preview. Connect its local state to your application's appearance setting.
look: A single off-white rounded button with a soft top-to-bottom gradient, a gold outline sun icon and a grey label, centred on pale grey.
motion: Hover spins the sun 360° (700 ms) and sweeps a highlight across (500 ms); toggling crossfades the label and page colour over 250 ms and turns the sun 180°.
adapt: All motion is CSS in the inline style block: `.sf-theme-sun` rotation with `cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)`, the `.sf-theme-label` crossfade and `.sf-theme-shine` sweep, keyed off `data-dark`. Replace the local `dark` state with your app's appearance setting.
